label: Brownfield
definition: Previously developed land, as the NPPF glossary (Annex B) defines it, including large areas of hardstanding.

label: Brownfield: greyfield
definition: Brownfield land in current but underused commercial, retail or light-industrial use, such as a retail or business park. No statutory definition.

label: Greenfield
definition: Land that has not been previously developed. In general use; not defined in the NPPF.

label: Mixed
definition: A cluster or area that includes both brownfield and greenfield land.
